title: Course Director UX UI and AI
description:
You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors:Â lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

Weâre a flexible team, and youâll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Writer and Editor, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. OurÂ Education DesignersÂ hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders toÂ create educational content for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills inÂ timeless, human-centered design and AI.

  • Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.Â The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.

  • You don't need a design background.Â Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

  • Write for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

  • Be the voice of IxDF.Â Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours.Â Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

  • Turn expert material into lessons.Â Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

  • Our coursesÂ combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, givingÂ constructive feedbackÂ on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia.Â We're always learning, always improving, always raising the barÂ in everything we do.

  • Weâre committed toâ¯excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

  • Maintain and improve ourÂ crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll developÂ personally and professionally.

  • We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?

People don't just buy our courses; they invest in a better version of themselves and a career they truly love. That's why every course we create and every sentence we write must do more than just inform. It must reflect the high-quality research and hands-on skills we teach.

  • Show the dream outcome: Help people imagine a future of creative, meaningful work, fulfillment, and impact through a career in design and AI.

  • Strengthen belief in success: Build confidence through real stories, practical case studies, and hands-on templates.

  • Overcome barriers: Write in a way that's crystal clear, human, and motivating. Connect and lead the way.

You'll educate, inspire, energize, and support. Whether you write a course article or give editorial feedback on a video, you'll help designers thrive in the age of AI.

About You

  • You have at least 4 years of professional writing or editing experience.

  • What matters far more than the number is the quality of the work you can show us: a course, an article series, a set of scripts, documentation, a newsletter. Weâre excited to hear what it was, why you wrote it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

  • You're aÂ master communicatorÂ with aÂ sharp eye for detailÂ andÂ strong skills in language, tone, and flow.

  • You can take a complex idea and write it so a beginner gets it on the first read.

  • You know how to hook someone with a title and a first line, and you know the difference betweenÂ a hook that's earnedÂ and a hook that's cheap.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to write, research, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, soÂ the outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • Youâre eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You can write for a career changer and for an experienced designer without losing either one.

  • You have anÂ exceptional talent for creating structure, and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about UX and UI design, and you're motivated to learn how great design shapes experiences and solves problems.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathyÂ to engage well with very different kinds of people.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy.

  • You takeÂ full ownershipÂ of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You work well with great responsibility and freedom inside a well-documented, structured system. Accuracy and attention to detail are key on an online learning platform, where every tag must be correct and every piece of text formatted to our upload system. It's in your nature to meticulously double-check that everything is in order.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ taught in classrooms or workshops, orÂ you've created educational material.

  • You have yourÂ own blog or social media pageÂ where you create and share original content.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

  • You've writtenÂ quiz or assessment questions.

  • You've worked with anÂ LMS or an online learning platform.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in communications, journalism, literature, or a similar field.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role:Â You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impactÂ that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. Your words will be read year after year, by hundreds of thousands of people who build better careers and design a better world for all of us.Â An education you can't buy:Â free access to every IxDF course and Master Class, and a job that requires you to study the work of the best designers alive in order to edit it. Most people pay for this. You'll be paid for it.

  • Access:Â the designers whose books you'd normally buy are the people whose words you'll be shaping, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with.

  • Studio shoots:Â once you know our courses well, usually after your first year, you'll be a real asset on a studio production, and you'll be welcome to join us when we meet our experts in professional studios around the world. Some of us love that part and go every time; others keep travel to a minimum. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Autonomy:Â Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses read.

  • A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, orÂ corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

  • If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, youâre in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then youâll find virtuallyÂ limitless opportunities with us.

  • We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll helpÂ set a direction that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.Â

title: Lead Estimator
description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills


If this sounds like you please APPLY reach out to Ebony Ison, ebony.ison@complexco.com.au


This role is also advertised on SEEK Lead Estimator Job in Canberra ACT - SEEK

title: Renewables Project Scheduler
description:
Apply

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

TAKKION is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Salary Description

$90,000-$130,000

title: Senior Kotlin Engineer (m/f/d) - B2B Sales & Distribution team
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.

B2B Sales & Distribution team in Demand Division builds and operates the backend platform powering Flix's partner-facing ecosystem — including a self-management platform for partners, a back office portal for internal users, and an AI agentic bot supporting partner operations. As a Senior Kotlin Backend Engineer (m/f/d), you can make an impact by supporting a significant modernization of backend architecture and working in an AI-native development environment.

About the Role

  • Design and develop backend services in Kotlin and Spring Boot
  • Build and maintain REST APIs used by internal and external partners
  • Participate in architectural decisions and technical modernization initiatives
  • Improve observability, performance, and reliability of backend systems using DataDog
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes
  • Work in and contribute to an AI-native development environment — including AI-integrated code review automation and an internal Claude Code plugin marketplace covering engineering standards: Kotlin/Spring Boot conventions, architectural patterns, testing practices, database guidelines, and team-specific conventions.

About You

  • 5+ years of professional backend development experience with JVM languages with at least 2 years of commercial experience with Kotlin
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot 
  • Experience building and maintaining REST APIs and distributed systems
  • Solid SQL knowledge and relational database design, including MySQL and PostgreSQL
  • Sound software engineering fundamentals, clean code practices, and familiarity with ORM and persistence layers
  • Collaborative and pragmatic, comfortable working in cross-functional Agile teams
  • Preferred: AWS, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Kafka, Terraform, LLM integrations, RAG systems, AI product development, or legacy system migration experience

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Fullstack Entwickler NestJS / Angular (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern, eingebettet in deren Teams, mit voller Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung komplexer Web-Anwendungen, Node-Backend und Angular-Frontend
  • Event-getriebene Services: Messaging über RabbitMQ, Echtzeit-Kommunikation über WebSockets
  • Datenmodell und Abfrage-Performance in PostgreSQL
  • Architektur mitgestalten, nicht nur umsetzen
  • Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor
  • Code Reviews und technisches Mentoring im Team
  • Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, UX und DevOps

Die meisten kommen ein bis zwei Tage die Woche in eins der Büros. Zwang ist das aber keiner. Beim Kunden vor Ort bist du nur für einzelne Termine alle paar Wochen.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt und deiner Erfahrung:

  • Transport & Logistik – Systeme mit hohem Datendurchsatz und Echtzeit-Anforderungen
  • Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel (eisenbahnspezifische Domänen: Fahrplanmanagement, Vertrieb, Leit- und Sicherungstechnik)
  • Öffentlicher Sektor / Behörden (z. B. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei) – regulierte Umgebungen, Barrierefreiheit, Security by Design
  • Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen

Erfahrung in einem dieser Umfelder ist ein starkes Plus – sag uns in den Fragen, wo du herkommst.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

Backend-Kern (das erwarten wir):

  • NestJS mit TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js)
  • PostgreSQL: Datenmodellierung, Migrationen, Query-Tuning
  • RabbitMQ und asynchrone, event-getriebene Kommunikation
  • WebSockets für Echtzeit-Funktionen
  • REST- und API-Design
  • Tests gehören bei uns zur Definition of Done, nicht in die Nacharbeit
  • CI/CD, Git, Docker, agiles Arbeiten

Frontend (das erwarten wir):

  • Angular mit TypeScript

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • Kubernetes, AWS oder Azure
  • Monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus), Frontend-Tests (Jest, Playwright, Cypress)
  • Erfahrung mit modernen Web-Architekturen und dem Zuschnitt von Services
  • Barrierefreiheit (BITV 2.0 / WCAG AA), DevSecOps / Security by Design

Wichtig ist, dass du auf beiden Seiten sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest. Zu den genannten Kern-Technologien erwarten wir jeweils mehrere abgeschlossene Projekte, die du im Lebenslauf zeigen kannst.

Projektsprache ist Deutsch

Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, auf Deutsch, in Meetings und in der Dokumentation. Wir erwarten Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau oder ein C2-Zertifikat.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

  • Homeoffice, Büro oder Mix, du entscheidest
  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner
  • Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) - Information Security
description:

Die dpa-IT Services GmbH ist das IT-Rückgrat der Deutschen Presse-Agentur (dpa) - einer der führenden unabhängigen Nachrichtenagenturen weltweit. Als Tochterunternehmen der dpa verantworten wir IT-Infrastruktur, geschäftskritische Anwendungen, moderne Cloud- und Rechenzentrumsinfrastrukturen sowie digitale Arbeitsplätze für die gesamte dpa-Gruppe.

Du + Deine Stärken

  • Grundlegendes Verständnis und/oder erste praktische Erfahrung im Bereich IT, IT/Cyber-Sicherheit oder IT-Compliance sind wünschenswert
  • Erste Kenntnisse in Informationssicherheitsstandards wie ISO 27001 oder BSI-Grundschutz sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab


Wir + Unsere Kultur

  • Echte Einblicke in die Welt der IT- und Informationssicherheit 
  • Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Spielraum für Ideen und Ausgestaltung 
  • Ein erfahrenes Team, das dich fachlich begleitet und bei deiner Entwicklung unterstützt. 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz direkt an der Alster und mit hauseigener Kantine
  • Mobiles Arbeiten in Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft möglich 
  • Eine faire Vergütung 


Klingt gut?

Wenn du Lust hast, die Informationssicherheit bei Deutschlands größter Nachrichtenagentur mitzugestalten, dann bewirb dich einfach und schnell über unser Onlineformular. Deine HR-Ansprechperson ist Celine Bock.

  • Implementing those algorithms in C++ and Python (and Matlab/Simulink when it fits)
  • Designing and running test benches that reveal true system performance
  • Building software for data acquisition and processing
  • Identifying dynamic system properties
  • Connecting the stack end to end: embedded firmware, middleware, backends, and analysis platforms
  • Hunting down and fixing interoperability issues across systems and devices


Your experience and qualifications

  • 3+ years as a control system engineer or mathematician
  • 3+ years in embedded software development, building scalable, high-performance systems
  • Strong grounding in control theory, advanced control algorithms, and DSP
  • Solid proficiency in C++, Python, and Matlab
  • Enough electrical and mechanical fluency to read schematics and reason about sensors and components
  • Working knowledge of electric motors and motor control
  • Familiarity with communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet, EtherCAT, TCP/IP)
  • Comfort with professional tooling (git, GitLab, Confluence, JIRA, etc.)
  • Experience with robotic systems is a strong plus

title: Head of Product (all genders)
description:
Kertos Intro

Kertos is the fastest-growing compliance startup in Europe.

Following our €14M Series A, backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the compliance engine for Europe – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever.
With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane, leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time.

The market is growing by 20% every year, fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act. We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion.

There has never been a better moment to join our team.

Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.


Your purpose at Kertos

As Head of Product, you own Kertos's product vision and roadmap, and you're joining at a genuinely pivotal moment. The category is being redrawn: compliance is shifting from software as a service to service as software, where AI and automation do the work wherever they can and our compliance experts focus on the judgment calls that still need a human. Few companies get to shape a product at the point where that shift is actually happening. You will.

That means the roadmap in front of you is wide open. There are more good directions to take the product than we can pursue at once, across the segments we serve today and the ones we're growing into, and a real part of the job is choosing where to place the bets. You'll work closely with our compliance experts to understand exactly what clients need, and decide with your team and engineering where the line between automation and human judgment sits today, with the mandate to push it forward quarter after quarter as AI takes on more of the work.

This role sits at the center of the product organization and value creation. You set the roadmap across squads, and you lead and grow the product team, partnering closely with our compliance experts and building around their knowledge, their needs, and their day-to-day work. You're accountable for the roadmap, for how the product team operates, and for outcomes clients can feel directly: time saved, risk reduced, audits passed.

Your responsibilities

  • Set the product vision, defining where Kertos product goes next, the shift from compliance software clients operate themselves to a service that delivers compliance outcomes for them, and turn that vision into a roadmap built around client value, not just feature velocity.
  • Partner closely with our compliance experts to learn what actually creates value for them and our customers, and work with our Development Team to turn that expertise into a product that makes their work faster and clients' outcomes better.
  • Continue to develop and mentor four product managers and two designers as the team scales, set the standards for how they run discovery and shipping, and make sure they grow into stronger PMs under you.
  • Optimize the discovery process and work closely with compliance experts, design and engineering to understand problems deeply, validate ideas with real clients before building, and ship improvements that move a client's compliance outcome.
  • Understand needs of customers, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing so product bets translate into revenue, retention, and measurable value for clients, especially as features move from "helps you do compliance" to "does the compliance work for you."
  • Own the roadmap, setting priorities independently, and aligning them with technical leads, our customer advisory board, key clients, and the leadership team.
  • Use data to define what success looks like for each initiative in terms clients would recognize, such as “time saved”, “risk mitigated”, “time to audit readiness”, and work with Marketing and Customer Success to turn usage data into the next round of decisions.



The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring

  • You've led product strategy in B2B SaaS as a Head of Product or similar, at a startup, scale-up, or an agile team inside a larger company and ideally have taken a product from idea through GA more than once.
  • You've hired, mentored, and managed product managers before, and know how to set clear expectations and give feedback that actually helps.
  • You successfully partner with compliance or legal experts who aren't engineers and turn their knowledge into product requirements
  • You are passionate about AI and enjoy using it to define new product processes
  • You are an ambitious and driven high-performer that wants to have a high impact on changing how compliance work gets done, excited about new user flows and AI-driven automation and is excited to take our compliance service & software product to series B ready.
  • Big plus if you bring technical engineering expertise that helps you to discuss frontend, backend, and cloud architecture and you can successfully turn complex technical and compliance topics into clear direction for engineering, sales, leadership, and customers.
  • Familiarity with GRC, information security, or privacy topics would be a great plus point, too.
  • German language skills are required for this position.


Why Kertos

  • You are Kertos: Don’t like something? Could be done better? You have the freedom to push things forward and contribute to making Kertos a great place to work
  • Unique opportunity: Join the growing team of one of Europe’s most promising early stages companies and to work directly with our COO Joe
  • European funding in the millions: The EU has funded our AI research with a total of over 2 million euros
  • Regular Feedback: We foster an open feedback culture and support your growth with regular 1-on-1 meetings
  • Full Flexibility: Whether at the Berlin office, our Munich HQ or at your home office – we are flexible, and you'll be happy
  • Keep growing: To boost your professional and personal growth, we provide you with a Personal Development Budget of 1.500€ per year
  • Cutting Edge Technology: Leading VCs have invested in our vision to revolutionize how compliance measures are handled sustainably
  • Mental Health: We've partnered with nilo to prioritize your well-being, offering personalized mental health support for all employees
  • For Sports Enthusiasts: We subsidize your Wellpass membership for your physical fitness for a better work-life balance
  • Steep learning curve: With us you get full responsibility from day 1, push topics forward independently and thus learn a lot
  • Strong onboarding: No idea about compliance and its automation? No problem, we'll turn you into an expert and provide you with an onboarding buddy
  • Teamwork Makes the Dream Work: We are a strong team that supports each other, and we also have a lot of fun together beyond work and across different locations


Sounds like you are the one we’ve been looking for?

Perfect, let's have a chat! Just send in your CV. We are excited to meet you soon.
In case you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our People & Culture team. We're happy to answer all your questions.

  • Frontend: Typescript, Vue 3, Tailwind, Netlify, GH Actions 
  • Backend: Typescript, AWS, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, REST, Websockets, Terraform, GH Actions


Who we're looking for

This role is perfect for a Frontend/Full Stack Engineer with 2-5 years of experience looking to grow their skills and make a meaningful impact at a company that is approaching product-market fit (> €2.5M ARR). You are likely a great fit if:

  • You believe in quality and want to build the best possible experience for our end users - because you care about them.

Beyond the role-specific requirements, you also see your own values reflected in our Culture Playbook.


What we offer

  • A company of co-owners through tax-optimized equity grants.
  • A culture with a focus on transparency, respect, ownership, collaboration and the well-being of each team member on this exciting journey.
  • An environment that values hard-work while still allowing work-life/family integration through 28 days PTO, flexible working hours, workation and a hybrid setup.
  • Dog-friendly with free lunch, besides beverages and snacks as well as a home office budget at start.
  • And more: Annual personal training budget of 1,500€ (FTE), Company supported pension Scheme (”BAV”, 30% contribution), Urban Sports Club Membership, Home Office budget and more.

title: Digital Project & Operations Manager:in (m/w/d)
description:
Vino Digital ist die E-Commerce-Agentur für die Weinbranche und ein Geschäftsbereich der TAFKA GmbH. Wir entwickeln für familiengeführte Weingüter Shops, Content, Kampagnen und digitale Systeme, die im Alltag funktionieren und messbare Ergebnisse liefern. Im zweiten Geschäftsbereich TAFKA helfen wir Unternehmen, KI und Automatisierung praktisch in ihre Arbeit zu integrieren.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine berufserfahrene Person, die digitale Projekte eigenständig führt, technische Themen sicher einordnet und bei Bedarf direkt in die Umsetzung geht. An einem Tag steuerst du ein Kundenprojekt, am nächsten löst du ein Problem mit Shop, DNS oder Tracking, schneidest ein Video in DaVinci Resolve oder entwickelst mit Claude und Codex einen besseren Workflow.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Du bringst Ordnung in komplexe Situationen, kommunizierst klar und führst Projekte zuverlässig zum Ergebnis. Wenn du Verantwortung magst, digitale Systeme schnell verstehst und einen vielseitigen Arbeitsalltag suchst, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Aufgaben

  • Digitale Projekte führen: Du übernimmst Vino-Digital-Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst Beteiligte und hältst Zeit, Qualität und nächste Schritte im Blick.
  • Kunden sicher begleiten: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für ausgewählte Partnerweingüter, führst Termine, übersetzt Ziele in klare Arbeitspakete und löst Probleme proaktiv.
  • Systeme weiterentwickeln: Du sammelst wiederkehrende Anforderungen, priorisierst Verbesserungen, formulierst saubere Briefings für Entwicklung und Automatisierung, testest neue Funktionen und dokumentierst den fertigen Prozess.
  • Technische Themen lösen: Du arbeitest sicher mit CMS, Domains, DNS-Einträgen, Formularen, Tracking und Integrationen. Bei Fehlern grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein und organisierst eine belastbare Lösung.
  • Web und E-Commerce umsetzen: Du pflegst und verbesserst Seiten in Shopify, WordPress oder vergleichbaren Systemen und kannst kleinere Anpassungen selbst durchführen.
  • Videos produzieren: Du schneidest Social-, Performance-, Schulungs- und Kunden-Videos in DaVinci Resolve, inklusive Auswahl, Dramaturgie, Ton, Untertiteln und passenden Exportformaten.
  • AI-first arbeiten: Du nutzt Claude und Codex täglich für Planung, Recherche, Dokumentation, Troubleshooting, Text, Prototyping und kleine technische Umsetzungen. Ergebnisse prüfst und verbesserst du eigenständig.
  • TAFKA unterstützen: Je nach Auslastung übernimmst du passende Aufgaben in KI-, Automatisierungs- oder Content-Projekten von TAFKA, etwa Projektkoordination, Prototyping, Video-Deliverables oder Qualitätssicherung.
  • Standards verbessern: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Reibung, entwickelst Vorlagen und Prozesse weiter und sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen im Team wiederverwendbar werden.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einer Agentur, einem Digitalunternehmen, einem E-Commerce-Team, einem Start-up oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mit.
  • Du hast mehrere digitale Projekte mit eigener Kunden- oder Stakeholder-Verantwortung geführt und kannst konkret erklären, welche schwierigen Situationen du gelöst und welche Ergebnisse du erreicht hast.
  • Du kommunizierst verbindlich, priorisierst klar und bleibst handlungsfähig, wenn Anforderungen unvollständig sind oder kurz vor einem Termin ein Problem auftaucht.
  • Du verstehst die Grundlagen von Domains und DNS. Begriffe wie A-Record, CNAME, MX und TXT sind dir vertraut.
  • Du hast bereits eine Website oder einen Shop mit WordPress, Shopify, Webflow oder einem vergleichbaren CMS umgesetzt oder wesentlich weiterentwickelt.
  • Du hast praktische Schnitt-Erfahrung mit DaVinci Resolve und kannst Arbeitsproben zeigen. Grundlagen bei Ton, Farbe, Untertiteln und Social-Formaten sitzen.
  • Du nutzt Claude, Codex oder vergleichbare KI-Werkzeuge routiniert und kannst zeigen, wie du damit Qualität, Tempo oder Problemlösung verbessert hast.
  • Du dokumentierst Entscheidungen und Prozesse so, dass andere damit weiterarbeiten können.
  • Du arbeitest auf Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau und kannst dich im beruflichen Alltag auf Englisch verständigen.
  • Du kannst regelmäßig in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz in Berlin arbeiten: 3 Tage pro Woche

Ein Studium ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Berufspraxis, dein Urteilsvermögen und die Ergebnisse, für die du bereits Verantwortung getragen hast. Erfahrung mit Vibe Coding, APIs, Webhooks oder Automationen ist willkommen.

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung: Du führst eigene Projekte und hast direkten Einfluss auf Kunden, Abläufe und Produktqualität.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Arbeit mit erkennbarem Kern: Projektmanagement bildet deine Basis. Technik, Systeme, Video und KI geben dir Raum, weitere Stärken einzusetzen.
  • Zwei spannende Arbeitsfelder: Du arbeitest überwiegend für Vino Digital und kannst dich zusätzlich in ausgewählte KI- und Automatisierungsprojekte von TAFKA einbringen.
  • AI-first-Umfeld: Claude, Codex und moderne Automatisierungswerkzeuge gehören zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Experimente können schnell zum neuen Standard werden.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Team und der Geschäftsführung und kannst Verbesserungen selbst anstoßen.
  • Gute Ausstattung: Du erhältst ein Firmen-MacBook und die Software, die du für deine Arbeit brauchst.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz, die übrige Zeit ist flexibel. Remote Work über einen abgestimmten Zeitraum nach Probezeit problemlos möglich.

Du hast schon erlebt, wie digitale Projekte in der Realität laufen: mit Kundenwünschen, Abhängigkeiten, technischen Überraschungen und Entscheidungen unter Zeitdruck. Du behältst den Überblick, packst selbst mit an und findest einen gangbaren nächsten Schritt.

Dann schick uns:

  • deinen Lebenslauf mit den Projekten, für die du selbst Verantwortung getragen hast
  • zwei bis drei kurze Projektbeispiele mit Ausgangslage, deiner Rolle und Ergebnis
  • mindestens eine Video-Arbeitsprobe
  • ein Beispiel, wie du Claude, Codex oder ein anderes KI-Werkzeug in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt hast

title: Senior Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
description:

Deine Aufgaben

  • Zahlungsverkehr durchführen: Du bereitest Zahlläufe vor, prüfst und führst diese durch und koordinierst bei Bedarf die Abstimmung mit Banken und externen Dienstleistern.

  • Buchhaltungsprozesse weiterentwickeln: Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale im Tagesgeschäft und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung unserer Buchhaltungs-, Abschluss- und Reporting-Prozesse ein.

Das bringst du mit

  • Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über mindestens fünf Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung und hast Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse bereits eigenständig erstellt. 
  • Fachlicher Hintergrund: Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finance, Accounting oder Rechnungswesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen. 
  • Abschluss- und Rechnungslegungskenntnisse: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Rechnungslegung und bist sicher in der bilanziellen Beurteilung und buchhalterischen Abbildung von Geschäftsvorfällen. 
  • DATEV-Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest sicher mit DATEV und verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für digitale Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussprozesse. 
  • Struktur und Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest sorgfältig, selbstständig und strukturiert. Auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen behältst du Fristen und Prioritäten zuverlässig im Blick. 
  • Lösungsorientierung: Du gehst Unstimmigkeiten eigenständig nach, hinterfragst Sachverhalte kritisch und entwickelst pragmatische sowie fachlich belastbare Lösungen. 
  • Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation: Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kommunizierst klar und verbindlich und trittst gegenüber internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partner:innen professionell auf. 
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind wünschenswert, aber keine Voraussetzung. Eine Weiterbildung zum/zur Bilanzbuchhalter:in oder Steuerfachwirt:in ist willkommen, für diese Position jedoch nicht erforderlich.


Deine Arbeitsweise

Du arbeitest präzise, eigenverantwortlich und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch. Du hinterfragst Zahlen und Sachverhalte, gehst Abweichungen konsequent nach und stellst sicher, dass Abschlüsse und buchhalterische Unterlagen jederzeit vollständig und nachvollziehbar sind. 

Dabei denkst du über einzelne Buchungen und Abschlusspositionen hinaus. Du erkennst Zusammenhänge, bringst Struktur in komplexe Themen und verstehst dich als verlässliche:r Sparringspartner:in für das Finance-Team und die angrenzenden Fachbereiche. 

Mit deiner Erfahrung gestaltest du bestehende Prozesse aktiv mit und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Finanzbuchhaltung mit dem weiteren Wachstum von EEF effizient, transparent und belastbar aufgestellt ist.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Fixgehalt plus leistungsabhängiger Bonus. 
  • Urlaubsregelung: 30 Tage Urlaub, mit einer Steigerung auf bis zu 35 Tage.

Warum EEF?

Bei EEF übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle beim weiteren Aufbau verlässlicher und professioneller Finance-Prozesse. Deine Arbeit schafft nicht nur Ordnung in der Buchhaltung, sondern bildet eine wichtige Grundlage für Transparenz, finanzielle Steuerung und das weitere Wachstum unseres Unternehmens.

title: Data Scientist / Data Engineer
description:
80 Beats Medical is a Berlin-based medical technology company developing innovative solutions for cardiovascular and vascular diagnostics.

Our VICORDER® platform enables non-invasive assessment of vascular health Building on this established technology, we are expanding our clinical diagnostic portfolio by combining medical device technology with advanced data analytics and AI.

Our goal is to transform complex physiological and cardiovascular data into reliable, clinically meaningful insights that can support earlier risk detection and better-informed clinical decisions.

We are a growing, international team working at the intersection of medical devices, software, data science, and clinical research.

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Data Engineer to help build the data and AI infrastructure behind our next generation of medical diagnostic solutions. You will work with high-frequency physiological and clinical data, developing secure and scalable data pipelines and supporting the transition of machine learning models from research into production-ready clinical applications.

You will work closely with our software, clinical, and regulatory teams in a highly interdisciplinary environment.

Tasks

  • Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure data ingestion and transformation pipelines. Implement automated ingestion, validation, lineage tracking, and quality monitoring.
  • Develop and maintain reusable data libraries, transformation logic, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure full compliance with GDPR, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (EU), HIPAA (US) and other global regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with implementation of Role-based access control (RBAC), Encryption in transit and at rest (HSM/KMS), Data anonymization & pseudonymization workflows and Consent handling and audit mechanisms.
  • Participate in security audits, compliance reviews, and certification efforts.
  • Operationalize AI pipelines including model deployment, monitoring, drift handling, versioning, and automated retraining.
  • Deploy explainable AI tooling (SHAP/LIME) into the pipeline for auditability and compliance.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows for data and ML workloads.
  • Develop Python-based analytics scripts, reusable data modules, and feature engineering logic.
  • Support visualization of workflows.
  • Ensure reproducibility and model traceability across the full lifecycle.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data science, AI, Cybersecurity, or similar.
  • 5+ years of experience building secure, compliant cloud-based data ecosystems ( for regulated data domains.
  • Hands-on experience with time-series data, sensor data, or biomedical/wearable data.
  • Knowledge of statistical programming
  • Strong understanding of ML approaches for classification, anomaly detection, and prediction using high-frequency data.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages
  • Advanced experience with Orchestration, Data frameworks, and Infrastructure automation.
  • Proven cross-functional communication skills.
  • Clear, documentation-driven engineering approach.

GOOD TO HAVE

  • Experience with multilevel longitudinal data, missing data strategies, and clinical outcome modeling.
  • Good working knowledge of either AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Hands on experience with Python and/or JavaScript including libraries for ML such as TensorFlow and PyTorch and visualization libraries such as Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or Streamlit
  • Previous work with Airflow, Dagster for Orchestration and Prefect, Spark, dbt, Kafka for data frameworks and Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm for infrastructure automation.
  • Knowledge of medical data formats (FHIR, HL7, DICOM).
  • Management of encryption standards and secure authentication

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A supportive and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients and healthcare professionals. You are at the forefront of developing technology that saves lives – what else is there?

Join our innovative Berlin team as a Data Scientist / Data Engineer to revolutionize cardiovascular diagnostics through cutting-edge technology and international collaboration. Be part of healthcare's future today!

An ideal candidate should have

Required:

  • 3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).
  • Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.

Preferred / Bonus:

  • Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load).
  • Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
  • Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.

What we offer

  • A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.

Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

Package: £80k OTE

 

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

 

 

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

 

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

 

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

 

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst- Consumer Growth
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
  • Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
  • Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
  • Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
  • Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
  • You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
  • You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
  • You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.

This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

About The Ickworth Hotel & Spa

Reopened following refurbishment!Set within 1,800 acres of National Trust parkland near Bury St Edmunds, The Ickworth Hotel & Spa is a grand Suffolk country house made for family adventures.

Inspired by the Grand Tour, and formerly home to the illustrious Hervey Family, Ickworth House is bursting at the seams with art and treasures.

The history of the Ickworth Estate is intrinsically tied to the Hervey family, who owned the estate for over 500 years. The Herveys gained prominence in British politics with members holding influential positions, including the 1st Earl of Bristol, who supported King George I during the Hanoverian succession.

The iconic Ickworth House, built in the 18th century by the 4th Earl of Bristol (the "Earl-Bishop"), was inspired by his European ‘Grand Tour' and originally intended to house the vast art collection he’d acquired on his travels. Designed in the Italian rotunda style by architect Antonio Asprucci, Ickworth was initially criticised for its style and extravagant scale – entirely in keeping with the Earl-Bishop’s infamously lavish lifestyle. His daughter Elizabeth was equally famous, though more notably for her scandalous private life. She was the mistress of the Duke of Devonshire, and lived with him and his wife Georgiana.

Ickworth House wasn’t finished during the Earl’s lifetime and his art collection was later confiscated by Napoleon’s forces. The impressive collection in the Rotunda today was built by generations of his descendants recreating the collection, and includes important works by Gainsborough, Reynolds, Hogarth, Titian, and Poussin.

description:
We're looking for an Account Executive to close new-logo business for Cytix in a market where most of the people you're calling haven't heard of us yet.

This is a full-cycle closing role: you'll run discovery, demo and negotiation yourself, with support from the CRO on the harder deals while you build that muscle.

You'll carry mid-market opportunities to start, working alongside SDR-sourced pipeline as well as your own prospecting, with a clear path to Senior Account Executive as your quota, deal complexity and independence grow.

What you'll do

What you'll bring

  • A track record at or near 100% of quota (around £500k–£750k) in at least one of the last two years.

  • Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them.

  • Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start.

  • Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked.

  • Genuinely bright and inquisitive: good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured.

  • Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance.

  • Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory.

What you'll get

  • Unlimited Holidays!

  • Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too.

  • Private Healthcare (inc. dental, optical and hearing)

  • Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice

  • Dog-friendly office.

  • Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.
